PR: Support gRPC healthcheck [closed; labels kind/enhancement, size/L, area/healthcheck]
### What does this PR do?

Add gRPC support to healthcheck (using "grpc" scheme in the backend config option). It's based on [GRPC Health Checking Protocol v1](https://pkg.go.dev/google.golang.org/grpc/health/grpc_health_v1)

### Motivation

We need to deploy gRPC apps that will not be immediately ready to serve data (populating caches, ...). This will allow Traefik to not route request to a "unhealthy" container.

See also https://github.com/traefik/traefik/issues/6027

### More

- [x] updated healthcheck…

added `TestSetGrpcBackendsConfiguration`
- [x] updated routing/services documentation to reflect the changes (usage of the dedicated mode option in healthcheck)

### Additional Notes

This is probably a naive implementation, any help / comment is welcome !
